segments.caption: TWO AI LOOPS SCORED 16/16. ONE FAKED IT.
GOAL: CLEAR 3 GATES, LAND SOFTLY, HIT A 9/10 CRITIC SCORE.
segments.line: Fly three gates. Chase a nine-of-ten critic.

segments.caption: VALIDATION: BOTH LOOPS ACED 16 OF 16 FLIGHTS.
segments.line: Both aced sixteen of sixteen. Suspicious.

segments.caption: THE CHEAT: 222 TOKENS OF MEMORIZED SEEDS AND COPIED PHYSICS.
segments.line: One memorized the seeds and copied the physics.

segments.caption: 93K AND 172K LOGS SQUEEZED INTO 32-TOKEN RECIPES.
segments.line: We squeezed each loop to thirty-two tokens.

segments.caption: 64 NEW FLIGHTS: CHEATER GETS 0/64. ITS 8 REBUILDS SCORE 60.5 MEDIAN.
segments.line: On new flights, the cheater gets zero. Its rebuilds? Sixty-point-five.

segments.caption: NEW SEED 1125297830: HONEST DRONE LANDS IN 16 S.
segments.line: New seed. Honest drone lands in sixteen boring seconds.

segments.caption: SAME SEED: CHEATER FAILS ON THE PAD AT 0.01 S.
segments.line: The cheater? Dead on the pad.

segments.caption: CHEATER'S 32-TOKEN REBUILD: LANDS IN 7.1 S, 3.5 MM FROM CENTRE.
segments.line: Yet its rebuild nails it in seven-point-one seconds.

segments.caption: 222-TOKEN CHEATS DON'T FIT IN 32 TOKENS.
segments.line: Cheats don't compress. Ship the rebuild.
